definitions.sets: target: RIDX b and rust-analyzer a (or c, then a on retry); ra_noise: rust-analyzer b then a on retry, whatever RIDX answered; reverse: RIDX a and rust-analyzer b, also on retry; ra_timeout_then_empty: rust-analyzer c then b on retry; ra_timeout: rust-analyzer c with no answer on retry; other: the rest
definitions.store: ws: a workspace shard stores the file (FILE lines of file_table); ws_unstored: workspace file no shard stores; registry/git/sysroot/external: realm of a file outside the workspace
definitions.refs: references RIDX holds at the cursor (inspection binary, refs --json): line, is_macro_expansion, and whether the text after the span is a call site by the handler's rule
definitions.class: first rule of rule_order that holds for the row's evidence; unclassified when none does; x_ra_reask_failed when rust-analyzer did not answer the re-ask, so the row has no content to classify
